packageRules.description: patches: one grouped pr overnight, automerged once ci is green
minors: one grouped pr on monday morning, merged by hand

0.x never automerges: semver lets a 0.x package break in a patch, so these ride the monday pr for a human to read. renovate's own matchUpdateTypes docs say to do this. last rule on purpose — later rules win, so this overrides the patch tier above. matchCurrentVersion prefers the locked version, so it catches a 0.x behind a range too.
